items.source: The ScopeMetadataResolver to be used for resolving the scope of detected components.
items.translation: 用于解析检测到的组件范围的ScopeMetadataResolver接口。

items.source: Note that the <context:component-scan> element has an annotation-config attribute; however, this annotation does not. This is because in almost all cases when using @ComponentScan, default annotation config processing (for example, processing @Autowired and friends) is assumed. Furthermore, when using AnnotationConfigApplicationContext, annotation config processors are always registered, meaning that any attempt to disable them at the @ComponentScan level would be ignored.
items.translation: 请注意，`` 元素具有 `annotation-config` 属性，但此注解没有。这是因为在几乎所有使用 `@ComponentScan` 的情况下，都假定会进行默认的注解配置处理（例如处理 `@Autowired` 等）。此外，当使用 AnnotationConfigApplicationContext 时，注解配置处理器始终会被注册，这意味着任何试图在 `@ComponentScan` 级别禁用它们的尝试都会被忽略。

items.source: Either basePackageClasses() or basePackages() (or its alias value()) may be specified to define specific packages to scan. If specific packages are not defined, scanning will occur recursively beginning with the package of the class that declares this annotation.
items.translation: 可以指定 `basePackageClasses()` 或 `basePackages()`（或其别名 `value()`）来定义要扫描的特定包。如果未定义特定包，则将从声明此注解的类的包开始递归进行扫描。

items.source: @ComponentScan can be used as a repeatable annotation. @ComponentScan may also be used as a meta-annotation to create custom composed annotations with attribute overrides.
items.translation: @ComponentScan 可用作一个 可重复 注解。@ComponentScan 也可用作 元注解，以创建具有属性覆盖的自定义 组合注解。

items.source: Locally declared @ComponentScan annotations always take precedence over and effectively hide @ComponentScan meta-annotations, which allows explicit local configuration to override configuration that is meta-present (including composed annotations meta-annotated with @ComponentScan).
items.translation: 本地声明的 `@ComponentScan` 注解始终优先于并实际上 隐藏 `@ComponentScan` 元注解，这允许显式的本地配置覆盖以 元方式存在 的配置（包括由带有 `@ComponentScan` 元注解的复合注解所存在的配置）。

items.source: The default value of the BeanNameGenerator interface itself indicates that the scanner used to process this @ComponentScan annotation should use its inherited bean name generator, for example, the default AnnotationBeanNameGenerator or any custom instance supplied to the application context at bootstrap time.
items.translation: `BeanNameGenerator` 接口本身的默认值表明，用于处理此 `@ComponentScan` 注解的扫描器应使用其继承的 Bean 名称生成器，例如默认的 `AnnotationBeanNameGenerator` 或在启动时向应用程序上下文提供的任何自定义实例。

items.source: Supports ${...} placeholders which are resolved against the Environment as well as Ant-style package patterns — for example, "org.example.**".
items.translation: 支持针对Environment解析的${...}占位符，以及 Ant 风格的包模式——例如"org.example.**"。

items.source: Consider use of includeFilters() and excludeFilters() for a more flexible approach.
items.translation: 考虑使用includeFilters()和excludeFilters()来实现更灵活的方法。

items.source: Multiple packages or patterns may be specified, either separately or within a single String — for example, {"org.example.config", "org.example.service.**"} or "org.example.config, org.example.service.**".
items.translation: 可以指定多个包或模式，可以是分开的，也可以包含在单个 `String` 中——例如，`{"org.example.config", "org.example.service.**"}` 或 `"org.example.config, org.example.service.**"`。

items.source: See @Configuration's Javadoc for usage examples.
items.translation: 参见 `@Configuration` 的 Javadoc，其中包含使用示例。

items.source: Allows for more concise annotation declarations if no other attributes are needed — for example, @ComponentScan("org.example") instead of @ComponentScan(basePackages = "org.example").
items.translation: 如果不需要其他属性，则允许使用更简洁的注解声明——例如，使用 `@ComponentScan("org.example")` 而不是 `@ComponentScan(basePackages = "org.example")`。

items.source: value() is an alias for (and mutually exclusive with) this attribute.
items.translation: value() 是该属性的别名（且与之互斥）。

items.source: Use basePackageClasses() for a type-safe alternative to String-based package names.
items.translation: 使用basePackageClasses()作为基于字符串的包名的类型安全替代方案。

items.source: Note that setting this attribute overrides any value set for scopeResolver().
items.translation: 注意，设置此属性会覆盖为scopeResolver()设置的任何值。

items.source: Further narrows the set of candidate components from everything in basePackages() to everything in the base packages that matches the given filter or filters.
items.translation: 进一步缩小候选组件的范围，从 `basePackages()` 中的所有组件，缩小到与给定过滤器或过滤器匹配的基础包中的所有内容。

items.source: Default is false; switch this to true when desired.
items.translation: 默认值为false；需要时将其切换为true。

items.source: Provides support comparable to Spring's <context:component-scan> XML namespace element.
items.translation: 提供与 Spring 的 `<context:component-scan>` XML 命名空间元素相当的支持。

items.source: Note that these filters will be applied in addition to the default filters, if specified. Any type under the specified base packages which matches a given filter will be included, even if it does not match the default filters (i.e. is not annotated with @Component).
items.translation: 注意，这些过滤器将在指定默认过滤器的基础上额外应用。 任何位于指定基础包下且匹配给定过滤器的类型都将被包含在内，即使它不匹配默认过滤器（即未使用 `@Component` 注解）。

items.source:
Consider creating a special no-op marker class or interface in each package
that serves no purpose other than being referenced by this attribute.
items.translation: 在每个包中创建一个特殊的无操作标记类或接口，其唯一用途是被此属性引用。

items.source:
The default is defer to the default behavior of the component scanner used to
execute the actual scan.
items.translation: 默认值为 defer，即委托给用于执行实际扫描的组件扫描器的默认行为。

items.source: Indicates whether automatic detection of classes annotated with @Component @Repository, @Service, or @Controller should be enabled.
items.translation: 指示是否应启用带有 `@Component``、`@Repository`、`@Service` 或 `@Controller` 注解的类的自动检测。

items.source: Declares the type filter to be used as an include filter or exclude filter.
items.translation: 声明要用作包含过滤器或排除过滤器的类型过滤器。

items.source: Type-safe alternative to basePackages() for specifying the packages to scan for annotated components.
items.translation: 用于指定要扫描以查找已注解组件的包的 `basePackages()` 的类型安全替代方案。

items.source: The BeanNameGenerator class to be used for naming detected components within the Spring container.
items.translation: 用于在 Spring 容器中对检测到的组件进行命名的 BeanNameGenerator 类。

items.source: Alias for basePackages().
items.translation: ``basePackages()` 的别名。

items.source: Specifies which types are not eligible for component scanning.
items.translation: 指定不适用于组件扫描的类型。

items.source: Base packages to scan for annotated components.
items.translation: 要扫描已注解组件的基础包。

items.source: Specifies which types are eligible for component scanning.
items.translation: 指定组件扫描适用的类型。

items.source: Specify whether scanned beans should be registered for lazy initialization.
items.translation: 指定是否应注册已扫描的 Bean 以进行延迟初始化。

items.source: Controls the class files eligible for component detection.
items.translation: 控制可用于组件检测的类文件。

items.source:
Indicates whether proxies should be generated for detected components, which may be
necessary when using scopes in a proxy-style fashion.
items.translation: 指示是否应为检测到的组件生成代理，这在以代理方式使用范围时可能是必要的。

items.source: Chris Beams, Juergen Hoeller, Sam Brannen
items.translation: Chris Beams, Juergen Hoeller, Sam Brannen
